description: Changes ONE install-wide WebinarIgnition setting: the sender name, the sender address, the reply-to address, the email signature, the footer text, or one of the switches for footer branding, unsubscribe links and email verification. Side effect: it writes on the connected WordPress site. These settings apply to EVERY webinar on the site and to every email it sends, not only the one in this chat, so say that in one sentence before you write. Needs `session_id`, `field` and `value`. Only this fixed list is writable; anything else (licence, webhooks, legal texts) is refused by the site. For the colours of the emails use wi_change_webinar_colors with target email.

field.description: Which setting to change. One per call.

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

value.description: The new value. For a switch pass true or false, for the rest the text itself.

name: wi_change_site_settings
title: Change one WebinarIgnition setting of the whole site
